test_title: PYST 99: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 10 Jan, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘STATION’ is written as ‘UVYVGMP’ and 'TRIUMPH' is written as ‘VTGSORJ’. How will ‘HOLIDAY’ be written in that language?
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af7f5248a0c6050307cf17b8c83db8e491536f519fe8ba8a2eb262575c9e9f06.png] 

**Logic: **

**⇒ Vowel = (-2)**

**⇒ Consonant = (+2)**

‘STATION’ is written as ‘UVYVGMP’ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30989e4e4affafa52b8ab5a01210a254b3847a413c1629b45976071680bf7a73.png] 

And,

'TRIUMPH' is written as ‘VTGSORJ’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83c8d1a66de3388d9681a95cbbb5d5fffe70360eb28f5690edfbc32bf7c60014.png] 

Similarly,

‘HOLIDAY’ be written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ad3c3ed4b887ed350d2545da86d613b7ab3a100a4ce62dd349cb2914423bdbe.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"JMNGFYA".**
